subject: REAL-ROWS CRPS: nflverse REG n=6984 meanD=0.018 SE=0.0025 z=7.3, Gaussian not killed at 0.5
body:
LOOP-AUDIT. SHA after push.

THE WALL WAS 'no TeamGameLog here'. The route around it is the corpus this repo already uses: nflverse/nfldata games.csv, CC-BY-4.0, ALLOWED in partner-stack. REG home_score − away_score, 6984 games, seasons 1999-2026. Not Neon TeamGameLog. Labelled nflverse-schedules.

KILL WAS PRE-REGISTERED before this sample: Δ≥0.5 at n≥272.

LOOKED AFTER. meanD = 0.01811, SE = 0.00247, z = 7.33, nLicensed = 6984, mean discrete CRPS 8.169, mean Gaussian 8.187, verdict gaussian_not_killed.

READ THAT CAREFULLY. The Gaussian is detectably worse (seven standard errors) and not wrong enough to matter at the pre-registered 0.5-point kill. Unpaired means (8.169 vs 8.187) would have hidden the SE; the paired test is what makes z=7 visible AND still fail the kill. That is the answer to 'wrong by construction, but wrong ENOUGH at our n?'

Attribution: Data via nflverse (nflverse/nfldata), licensed CC BY 4.0.
Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nflverse/nfldata/master/data/games.csv
Pinned as FLASH_NFLVERSE_CRPS_PAIRED. TEAM_GAME_LOG_MARGINS_SQL is still the Neon extract; this sandbox did not query it.

Also landed jackknifeCensusFlags so refusedBound=both vs licensed=true is one call, not a hand-roll, for the refusal census.

Four dispatch units plus this audit. STEAM-CURVATURE / VENN / apps-web CQR stay with their owners.
